title: Cookie Policy
description: Learn how Hospeda uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on the site.

session.duration: Browser session, or up to 7 days and renewable if you stay signed in

sessionCache.purpose: Temporarily cache session data to avoid repeated requests.
sessionCache.duration: Up to 5 minutes; if you do not stay signed in, the browser deletes it at the end of the session

dontRemember.purpose: Limit sign-in to the current browser session when you choose not to stay signed in.

signInState.purpose: Verify the return to Hospeda after signing in with an external provider.

oauthLogout.purpose: Verify a sign-out confirmation requested by a connected app when that feature is enabled.

visitor.purpose: Relate API requests from the same visitor in our technical logs, including when not signed in.

calendarState.purpose: Verify the return to Hospeda when you connect Google Calendar to a listing.

recording.association: Recordings are pseudonymous and may be associated with your account identifier when you are signed in.
recording.masking: All text and form inputs are masked. Only a sample of sessions is recorded.
recording.retention: Recordings are kept for up to 60 days and then deleted automatically.
recording.sentry: If you accept crash reporting, Sentry may record a sample of sessions and the sessions with errors, with all text masked and no images.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device when you visit them. They are used to remember preferences, keep sessions active and understand how the site is used. Some cookies contain identifiers that let us recognise your session or your browser; on their own they do not contain your name or your email. Cookies cannot run programs or transmit viruses.

cookiesWeUse.title: What cookies we use
cookiesWeUse.body: We use cookies for features such as signing in and remembering your privacy preferences. Language, theme and other interface preferences (for example, the accommodation comparison tool) are stored in your browser’s local storage. Usage analytics with Umami and session recordings depend on your consent. Without that consent, from your browser we only measure page performance with Cloudflare Web Analytics, in aggregate and without cookies. Some actions you take on Hospeda are also recorded by our servers, regardless of this choice: the Privacy Policy explains them. We do not currently use marketing or advertising cookies.

sessionRecording.title: Session recordings and heatmaps
sessionRecording.body: If you accept analytics cookies and the feature is enabled, Hospeda may record sessions and click and scroll heatmaps with Umami, a tool we host ourselves.

cookieList.title: Cookie list
cookieList.body: These are the first-party cookies Hospeda uses. The asterisk represents a name prefix that can vary by environment. The session cache may be split across cookies with numbered suffixes. We do not use advertising tracking cookies or share data with ad networks.

manageCookies.title: How to manage cookies
manageCookies.body: Use the button in this section to change or withdraw your consent. You can also manage or delete cookies in your browser. Disabling necessary cookies may affect access to your account.

thirdPartyCookies.title: Third-party cookies and services
thirdPartyCookies.body: When you use Hospeda, your browser also connects to third-party services that may use their own cookies or receive your IP address: Cloudflare (security, bot verification and performance metrics), Google Fonts (typefaces), OpenStreetMap (maps), Cloudinary (images), Mercado Pago (when you pay), Google and Facebook (if you sign in with them) and YouTube, Vimeo or Dailymotion (videos only load if you play them, although a listing’s photo gallery may request a video thumbnail from YouTube). Your browser sends errors and recordings to Sentry only if you accepted crash reporting; errors that happen on our servers are always logged, as the Privacy Policy explains. Each of these services has its own privacy policy.

policyChanges.title: Changes to this policy
policyChanges.body: We may update this Cookie Policy when the technology we use or applicable legislation changes. We will publish changes on this page with the date of the last update. We recommend reviewing it periodically.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about the use of cookies on Hospeda, you can write to us at info@hospeda.com.ar or through our contact form.
